item.title: 3 Reasons Why This Canon Camera is The Most Used Device on Flickr
item.description: Canon has been one of the few companies that has the largest market share in the photo industry. While they have introduced some exceptional DSLRs over the years, their mirrorless models are not far behind. Flickr, which is now gaining momentum amongst the photography community, recently unveiled its 10 most used cameras, and the one that stood out the most was none other than Canon. Have a look.

item.title: Is Canon Working on a Lens That Could Change the Face of Compact Cameras?
item.description: Canon has multiple lenses in this portfolio, but it seems the company is not yet ready to call it a day. Per a new report, Canon is working on a new zoom lenses, which offer a bright aperture and a much better build. In a time when interchangeable-lens cameras have abundant lens options, Canon is pursuing a different strategy. Here is a look at what the company is offering and how.

item.title: Our Nikon D850 Review Has Been Updated
item.description: Yes, you're reading that correctly. In 2026, we're updating the Phoblographer's Nikon D850 review -- and it's for a very good reason. I bought one at the end of last year as a very conscious choice and after much deliberation. It's now one of my work cameras along with the Leica SL2s and the Panasonic LUMIX S1R II. You can read the entire review here. But if you want to follow just the updated text, please check it out below.

item.title: Want Sharper Photos? Our Presets Can Do That!
item.description: If you use Lightroom or Capture One, you'll want to see what our presets can do for you. Not only are they affordable, but they're specially designed to make images in a variety of both studio and natural lighting scenes stand out. This works for street photography, landscapes, portraits, etc.

item.title: There are So Many Good New Compact Cameras. Which One Should You Get?
item.description: If I were to look at the compact camera market today on a big photography retailer's website, I'd think that there aren't all that many compact cameras. But that would be wrong. Instead, they're all small businesses and working on little profits. These are labors of love, not made by billion-dollar companies, in many of the cases. And with that said, you're probably missing out on some of the best compact cameras on the market. So here are some of the ones that we love!

item.title: Megadap Just Built the World’s First Leica M to Canon RF Autofocus Adapter
item.description: Lens adapters have done a wonderful job of allowing people to take their favourite optics to their current system. Those who prefer Leica M lenses, however, can use them only on Leica's own cameras. With little option to adapt them to the mirrorless system, one may give up on the lenses altogether. But Megadap, a Hong Kong-based adapter specialist, has just announced a new solution: the world's first autofocus adapter that lets Leica M be used on Canon RF cameras. Here's a look.

item.title: The CP+ 2026 Lens Roundup: Viltrox May Have Bested Sony
item.description: After the closure of Photokina, the CP+ tradeshow in Japan became the central hub for photographers and manufacturers from around the world. This year, we saw some incredible innovations, but the spotlight was stolen by third-party lens manufacturers, who showcased a range of upcoming optics for users. This includes higher-end lenses, as well as affordable optics for photographers from various paths. Here's what you need to know.

item.title: Flashback 35 V2 Prices are Going Up Despite One Big Problem
item.description: If you've been enjoying the current trend of retro digital cameras and digicams, then you've probably heard of the Flashback 35 V2. We reviewed it a while back and consider it to be one of our favorites. And now, the price of the camera is going up by 10%. Despite that, there's still a problem.
